gloss: congratulations (on something you did or got)
notes: For a birthday or a holiday, say felicidades, not enhorabuena.

sentences.text: ¡Enhorabuena, has aprobado el examen!
sentences.translation: Congratulations, you passed the exam!

sentences.text: ¿Vais a ser padres? ¡Enhorabuena!
sentences.translation: You're going to be parents? Congratulations!

sentences.text: ¡Enhorabuena a los ganadores!
sentences.translation: Congratulations to the winners!

gloss: mood, spirits; encouragement; (¡ánimo!) come on, cheer up

sentences.text: ¡Ánimo, que ya queda poco!
sentences.translation: Come on, there's not much left!

sentences.text: Mi abuelo está muy bien de ánimo.
sentences.translation: My grandfather is in very good spirits.

sentences.text: Gracias por los ánimos.
sentences.translation: Thanks for the encouragement.

sentences.text: Pasamos una noche en un hotel de lujo.
sentences.translation: We spent a night in a luxury hotel.

sentences.text: Ya no hay dinero para lujos.
sentences.translation: There's no more money for luxuries.

sentences.text: Un baño caliente es todo un lujo.
sentences.translation: A hot bath is a real luxury.

sentences.text: En mi familia no hablamos de religión.
sentences.translation: In my family we don't talk about religion.

sentences.text: Respeto todas las religiones.
sentences.translation: I respect all religions.

sentences.text: Para mi abuela, la religión es muy importante.
sentences.translation: For my grandmother, religion is very important.

notes: me da risa = it makes me laugh.

sentences.text: Me encanta tu risa.
sentences.translation: I love your laugh.

sentences.text: Oímos risas en la cocina.
sentences.translation: We heard laughter in the kitchen.

sentences.text: Me muero de risa contigo.
sentences.translation: You crack me up.

notes: It does not usually mean sad; for that, say muy triste.

sentences.text: Vivían en una casa miserable, sin agua ni luz.
sentences.translation: They lived in a wretched house, with no water or electricity.

sentences.text: Fueron unos años miserables.
sentences.translation: Those were wretched years.

sentences.text: Es tan miserable que nunca invita a nadie.
sentences.translation: He's so stingy that he never treats anyone.

notes: An iron for clothes is una plancha.

sentences.text: La puerta del jardín es de hierro.
sentences.translation: The garden gate is made of iron.

sentences.text: Necesitas comer más hierro.
sentences.translation: You need to eat more iron.

sentences.text: Con ochenta años, tiene una salud de hierro.
sentences.translation: At eighty, she has an iron constitution.

sentences.text: La reina llevaba una corona de oro.
sentences.translation: The queen was wearing a gold crown.

sentences.text: Dejaron coronas de flores en la tumba.
sentences.translation: They left wreaths of flowers on the grave.

sentences.text: El niño llevaba una corona de papel en su cumpleaños.
sentences.translation: The boy wore a paper crown on his birthday.

sentences.text: Hay que apagar todos los dispositivos.
sentences.translation: All devices must be turned off.

sentences.text: Este dispositivo mide la temperatura.
sentences.translation: This device measures the temperature.

sentences.text: Puedes ver la serie en cualquier dispositivo.
sentences.translation: You can watch the series on any device.

sentences.text: Nunca menciona a su padre.
sentences.translation: He never mentions his father.

sentences.text: ¿Mencionó algo de la fiesta?
sentences.translation: Did she mention anything about the party?

sentences.text: Ya lo he mencionado dos veces.
sentences.translation: I've already mentioned it twice.

sentences.text: No lo menciones delante de mi madre.
sentences.translation: Don't mention it in front of my mother.

sentences.text: Después de pasar la enfermedad, tienes inmunidad.
sentences.translation: After you've had the illness, you have immunity.

sentences.text: La vacuna da inmunidad durante años.
sentences.translation: The vaccine gives immunity for years.

sentences.text: Pidió inmunidad a cambio de hablar.
sentences.translation: He asked for immunity in exchange for talking.

sentences.text: Escucha esta grabación.
sentences.translation: Listen to this recording.

sentences.text: La grabación dura tres minutos.
sentences.translation: The recording is three minutes long.

sentences.text: Tenemos grabaciones de las cámaras.
sentences.translation: We have recordings from the cameras.

sentences.text: Este año ha bajado la producción de coches.
sentences.translation: Car production has gone down this year.

sentences.text: Mi hermana trabaja en producciones de teatro.
sentences.translation: My sister works on theatre productions.

sentences.text: La fábrica quiere aumentar la producción.
sentences.translation: The factory wants to increase production.

sentences.text: Cerca del pueblo hay una central nuclear.
sentences.translation: There's a nuclear power plant near the village.

sentences.text: Mucha gente tiene miedo a la energía nuclear.
sentences.translation: A lot of people are afraid of nuclear power.

sentences.text: Las armas nucleares son muy peligrosas.
sentences.translation: Nuclear weapons are very dangerous.

gloss: climate (the usual weather of a place)
notes: For today's weather, say el tiempo: ¿qué tiempo hace?

sentences.text: El clima del sur es más seco.
sentences.translation: The climate in the south is drier.

sentences.text: Vine a vivir aquí por el clima.
sentences.translation: I came to live here for the climate.

sentences.text: La costa y la montaña tienen climas distintos.
sentences.translation: The coast and the mountains have different climates.

notes: The stress moves in the plural: caracteres.

sentences.text: Ella tiene un carácter muy dulce.
sentences.translation: She has a very sweet nature.

sentences.text: Es un niño de carácter tranquilo.
sentences.translation: He's a boy with a calm nature.

sentences.text: Mi hermano y yo tenemos caracteres muy distintos.
sentences.translation: My brother and I have very different natures.

notes: A mask against germs is usually una mascarilla.

sentences.text: Para la fiesta, todos llevan máscaras.
sentences.translation: Everyone is wearing masks for the party.

sentences.text: Por fin se quitó la máscara.
sentences.translation: He finally took off his mask.

sentences.text: El ladrón llevaba una máscara negra.
sentences.translation: The thief was wearing a black mask.

sentences.text: Tiene una forma de ser muy alegre.
sentences.translation: She has a very cheerful nature.

sentences.text: Esta canción es muy alegre.
sentences.translation: This song is really upbeat.

sentences.text: Esta habitación necesita colores alegres.
sentences.translation: This room needs bright colours.

sentences.text: Los dos partidos hicieron una alianza.
sentences.translation: The two parties made an alliance.

sentences.text: Ninguna alianza dura para siempre.
sentences.translation: No alliance lasts forever.

sentences.text: Los novios se pusieron las alianzas.
sentences.translation: The bride and groom put on their wedding rings.

notes: dar positivo = to test positive.

sentences.text: Intenta ser positivo.
sentences.translation: Try to be positive.

sentences.text: La prueba dio positivo.
sentences.translation: The test came back positive.

sentences.text: Hemos recibido respuestas muy positivas.
sentences.translation: We've received very positive responses.

sentences.text: Desafortunadamente, el tren ya había salido.
sentences.translation: Unfortunately, the train had already left.

sentences.text: Desafortunadamente, no queda ninguna mesa libre.
sentences.translation: Unfortunately, there are no free tables left.

sentences.text: El médico llegó tarde, desafortunadamente.
sentences.translation: The doctor arrived late, unfortunately.

sentences.text: Lleva la guitarra a todas partes.
sentences.translation: He takes his guitar everywhere.

sentences.text: A la guitarra le falta una cuerda.
sentences.translation: The guitar is missing a string.

sentences.text: En casa tenemos dos guitarras viejas.
sentences.translation: We have two old guitars at home.

sentences.text: Su estrategia funcionó muy bien.
sentences.translation: Her strategy worked very well.

sentences.text: Cambiamos de estrategia a mitad del partido.
sentences.translation: We changed strategy halfway through the game.

sentences.text: Hay varias estrategias para ahorrar dinero.
sentences.translation: There are several strategies for saving money.

notes: con frecuencia = often.

sentences.text: ¿Con qué frecuencia vas al médico?
sentences.translation: How often do you go to the doctor?

sentences.text: Los autobuses pasan con poca frecuencia.
sentences.translation: The buses don't come very often.

sentences.text: La policía usa otras frecuencias de radio.
sentences.translation: The police use other radio frequencies.

notes: Signs say Prohibido + an action: Prohibido fumar = No smoking.

sentences.text: Prohibido el paso.
sentences.translation: No entry.

sentences.text: En la piscina está prohibido correr.
sentences.translation: Running isn't allowed at the pool.

sentences.text: Los perros están prohibidos en esta playa.
sentences.translation: Dogs aren't allowed on this beach.

sentences.text: Siempre arruina los planes de los demás.
sentences.translation: He always ruins other people's plans.

sentences.text: La lluvia arruinó la boda.
sentences.translation: The rain ruined the wedding.

sentences.text: ¡Vas a arruinar la sorpresa!
sentences.translation: You're going to ruin the surprise!

sentences.text: Se ha arruinado con ese negocio.
sentences.translation: He's gone broke with that business.

gloss: dough; (en masa) in large numbers; (las masas) the masses, crowds

sentences.text: La masa tiene que descansar una hora.
sentences.translation: The dough needs to rest for an hour.

sentences.text: Mi abuela hace la masa del pan a mano.
sentences.translation: My grandmother makes the bread dough by hand.

sentences.text: La gente salió en masa a la calle.
sentences.translation: People came out onto the street in large numbers.

sentences.text: Ese cantante mueve masas.
sentences.translation: That singer draws huge crowds.

sentences.text: Nadie conocía la existencia de esa carta.
sentences.translation: Nobody knew about the existence of that letter.

sentences.text: Tuvo una existencia tranquila en el campo.
sentences.translation: She had a quiet existence in the country.

sentences.text: Lo siento, no nos quedan existencias.
sentences.translation: Sorry, we're out of stock.

sentences.text: El tren pasa por un túnel muy largo.
sentences.translation: The train goes through a very long tunnel.

sentences.text: Al salir del túnel, vimos el mar.
sentences.translation: Coming out of the tunnel, we saw the sea.

sentences.text: Bajo el río pasan dos túneles.
sentences.translation: Two tunnels run under the river.

sentences.text: Trabaja en la industria del cine.
sentences.translation: She works in the film industry.

sentences.text: El pueblo vive de la industria del vino.
sentences.translation: The town lives off the wine industry.

sentences.text: Algunas industrias hacen mucho daño al río.
sentences.translation: Some industries do a lot of harm to the river.

sentences.text: ¿Cuántos discos tienes en tu colección?
sentences.translation: How many records do you have in your collection?

sentences.text: La nueva colección de verano ya está en las tiendas.
sentences.translation: The new summer collection is in the shops now.

sentences.text: El museo tiene varias colecciones de arte.
sentences.translation: The museum has several art collections.

notes: Also used like bien and mal: me siento fatal = I feel awful.

sentences.text: El partido de ayer fue fatal.
sentences.translation: Yesterday's game was awful.

sentences.text: Lo siento, mi inglés es fatal.
sentences.translation: Sorry, my English is awful.

sentences.text: Las vacaciones fueron fatales por el tiempo.
sentences.translation: The holiday was awful because of the weather.

gloss: file, record (an official one about a person or case)

sentences.text: El médico miró mi expediente.
sentences.translation: The doctor looked at my medical file.

sentences.text: Su expediente en el colegio es perfecto.
sentences.translation: His school record is perfect.

sentences.text: Necesito ver los expedientes de estos alumnos.
sentences.translation: I need to see these students' records.

notes: a petición de = at the request of.

sentences.text: Lo hice a petición de tu madre.
sentences.translation: I did it at your mother's request.

sentences.text: Han rechazado todas nuestras peticiones.
sentences.translation: They've turned down all our requests.

sentences.text: La petición ya tiene mil firmas.
sentences.translation: The petition already has a thousand signatures.

gloss: presentation; introduction (of one person to another)

sentences.text: Mañana tengo una presentación en el trabajo.
sentences.translation: I have a presentation at work tomorrow.

sentences.text: Su presentación fue muy clara.
sentences.translation: His presentation was very clear.

sentences.text: Hizo las presentaciones y nos sentamos.
sentences.translation: She made the introductions and we sat down.

sentences.text: El accidente le dejó daños cerebrales.
sentences.translation: The accident left him with brain damage.

sentences.text: Los médicos miran su actividad cerebral.
sentences.translation: The doctors are checking his brain activity.

sentences.text: Su hijo nació con un problema cerebral.
sentences.translation: Her son was born with a brain condition.

gloss: courage, guts (to keep going in a hard situation)

sentences.text: Luchó con coraje contra la enfermedad.
sentences.translation: She fought the illness with courage.

sentences.text: Admiro el coraje de esa madre.
sentences.translation: I admire that mother's courage.

sentences.text: Los bomberos tuvieron un coraje enorme.
sentences.translation: The firefighters had enormous courage.

sentences.text: Mi hija es rubia como su padre.
sentences.translation: My daughter is blond like her father.

sentences.text: Un chico rubio preguntó por ti.
sentences.translation: A blond boy asked for you.

sentences.text: Sus hermanos son todos rubios.
sentences.translation: Her brothers are all blond.

notes: o changes to ue in some forms: almuerzas. In Spain, people often say comer for lunch. In some parts of Spain, almorzar means a mid-morning snack.

sentences.text: ¿Dónde almorzamos hoy?
sentences.translation: Where shall we have lunch today?

sentences.text: Almorcé con mis compañeros de trabajo.
sentences.translation: I had lunch with my coworkers.

sentences.text: ¿Almuerzas siempre en la oficina?
sentences.translation: Do you always have lunch at the office?

sentences.text: No quiero tu caridad.
sentences.translation: I don't want your charity.

sentences.text: Mañana hay una cena de caridad.
sentences.translation: There's a charity dinner tomorrow.

sentences.text: Lo hace por caridad, no por dinero.
sentences.translation: She does it out of charity, not for money.

sentences.text: Mira la hora de llegada en el billete.
sentences.translation: Check the arrival time on the ticket.

sentences.text: Desde su llegada, todo ha cambiado.
sentences.translation: Since her arrival, everything has changed.

sentences.text: En la pantalla salen las llegadas de hoy.
sentences.translation: Today's arrivals are on the screen.

sentences.text: Solo me queda un capítulo.
sentences.translation: I only have one chapter left.

sentences.text: Leo dos capítulos antes de dormir.
sentences.translation: I read two chapters before going to sleep.

sentences.text: En el primer capítulo muere el padre.
sentences.translation: In the first chapter, the father dies.

sentences.text: Este mes hemos tenido muchos gastos.
sentences.translation: We've had a lot of expenses this month.

sentences.text: La empresa paga los gastos del viaje.
sentences.translation: The company pays the travel costs.

sentences.text: Otro coche sería un gasto enorme.
sentences.translation: Another car would be a huge expense.

gloss: cake (a whole one, often for a celebration); tart
notes: In Spain, a pastel is often a small cake or pastry; a tarta is a whole cake.

sentences.text: ¡Sopla las velas de la tarta!
sentences.translation: Blow out the candles on the cake!

sentences.text: En la boda había una tarta de cinco pisos.
sentences.translation: At the wedding there was a five-tier cake.

sentences.text: Hoy he hecho dos tartas de queso.
sentences.translation: Today I made two cheesecakes.

sentences.text: Seré breve.
sentences.translation: I'll be brief.

sentences.text: El tren saldrá en breve.
sentences.translation: The train will leave shortly.

sentences.text: Las respuestas tienen que ser breves.
sentences.translation: The answers have to be brief.

sentences.text: El acero es más duro que el hierro.
sentences.translation: Steel is harder than iron.

sentences.text: Compré unos cuchillos de acero.
sentences.translation: I bought some steel knives.

sentences.text: En esta ciudad se hacía acero.
sentences.translation: Steel used to be made in this city.

sentences.text: Su confesión lo cambió todo.
sentences.translation: Her confession changed everything.

sentences.text: Tengo que hacerte una confesión.
sentences.translation: I have a confession to make.

sentences.text: El cura escucha confesiones antes de misa.
sentences.translation: The priest hears confessions before Mass.

sentences.text: ¿Tienes coartada para esa noche?
sentences.translation: Do you have an alibi for that night?

sentences.text: Esa coartada no se la cree nadie.
sentences.translation: Nobody believes that alibi.

sentences.text: Los dos tienen coartadas.
sentences.translation: Both of them have alibis.

notes: hacer el payaso = to clown around.

sentences.text: Para el cumpleaños vino un payaso.
sentences.translation: A clown came to the birthday party.

sentences.text: Los payasos hicieron reír a todos.
sentences.translation: The clowns made everyone laugh.

sentences.text: Deja de hacer el payaso.
sentences.translation: Stop clowning around.

notes: Very informal, used in Spain. Plural: guais.

sentences.text: ¡Qué guay tu bici!
sentences.translation: Your bike is so cool!

sentences.text: Tu hermano es muy guay.
sentences.translation: Your brother is really cool.

sentences.text: Mis primos son guais.
sentences.translation: My cousins are cool.

notes: A woman politician is una política, which also means politics.

sentences.text: Su padre era político.
sentences.translation: Her father was a politician.

sentences.text: Los políticos hablan mucho y hacen poco.
sentences.translation: Politicians talk a lot and do little.

sentences.text: Ningún político habló del tema.
sentences.translation: No politician talked about the issue.

sentences.text: Se dedica al diseño de muebles.
sentences.translation: She works in furniture design.

sentences.text: Este coche tiene un diseño moderno.
sentences.translation: This car has a modern design.

sentences.text: Hicimos varios diseños para el cartel.
sentences.translation: We made several designs for the poster.

sentences.text: Ella está convencida de que miento.
sentences.translation: She's convinced I'm lying.

sentences.text: No te veo muy convencido.
sentences.translation: You don't look very convinced.

sentences.text: Todos estaban convencidos de ganar.
sentences.translation: Everyone was convinced they would win.

sentences.text: ¿Dónde aprendiste italiano?
sentences.translation: Where did you learn Italian?

sentences.text: Entiendo bastante italiano.
sentences.translation: I understand quite a lot of Italian.

sentences.text: Conocimos a unos italianos en el viaje.
sentences.translation: We met some Italians on the trip.

sentences.text: Compré la camiseta de mi equipo.
sentences.translation: I bought my team's shirt.

sentences.text: Estas camisetas están de oferta.
sentences.translation: These T-shirts are on sale.

sentences.text: Duermo con una camiseta vieja.
sentences.translation: I sleep in an old T-shirt.

sentences.text: La noticia tuvo un gran impacto.
sentences.translation: The news had a big impact.

sentences.text: El conductor no sintió el impacto.
sentences.translation: The driver didn't feel the impact.

sentences.text: Hay impactos de bala en la pared.
sentences.translation: There are bullet holes in the wall.

notes: It's one word for all your bags: mi equipaje = my luggage.

sentences.text: No cabe todo el equipaje en el coche.
sentences.translation: Not all the luggage fits in the car.

sentences.text: Solo llevo equipaje de mano.
sentences.translation: I've only got hand luggage.

sentences.text: ¿Cuánto equipaje puedo llevar en el avión?
sentences.translation: How much luggage can I take on the plane?

sentences.text: Hay mucho sufrimiento en el mundo.
sentences.translation: There's a lot of suffering in the world.

sentences.text: Por fin acabó su sufrimiento.
sentences.translation: Her suffering finally ended.

sentences.text: La guerra trajo mucho sufrimiento.
sentences.translation: The war brought a lot of suffering.

sentences.text: Mis hijos ya son adolescentes.
sentences.translation: My kids are teenagers now.

sentences.text: De adolescente, mi padre era muy tímido.
sentences.translation: As a teenager, my father was very shy.

sentences.text: Un grupo de adolescentes jugaba al fútbol en el parque.
sentences.translation: A group of teenagers was playing football in the park.

sentences.text: Mi hermana sigue soltera.
sentences.translation: My sister is still single.

sentences.text: Ya no estoy soltero: tengo novia.
sentences.translation: I'm not single anymore: I have a girlfriend.

sentences.text: Mis dos tíos son solteros.
sentences.translation: Both my uncles are single.

sentences.text: Tiene mucha influencia en el pueblo.
sentences.translation: He has a lot of influence in the village.

sentences.text: Su música tiene influencias de muchos países.
sentences.translation: Her music has influences from many countries.

sentences.text: Sus amigos son una mala influencia.
sentences.translation: His friends are a bad influence.

sentences.text: Los árboles nos dan oxígeno.
sentences.translation: Trees give us oxygen.

sentences.text: En el hospital le pusieron oxígeno.
sentences.translation: At the hospital they put him on oxygen.

sentences.text: A esa altura casi no hay oxígeno.
sentences.translation: At that height there's almost no oxygen.

sentences.text: Hicimos un experimento en clase de ciencias.
sentences.translation: We did an experiment in science class.

sentences.text: El experimento ha sido un éxito.
sentences.translation: The experiment was a success.

sentences.text: No hagas experimentos con mi ordenador.
sentences.translation: Don't do experiments on my computer.

sentences.text: Es absurdo discutir por esto.
sentences.translation: It's absurd to argue about this.

sentences.text: Me hizo una pregunta absurda.
sentences.translation: He asked me an absurd question.

sentences.text: En mi trabajo hay normas absurdas.
sentences.translation: At my job there are absurd rules.

gloss: to give back, to return; to pay back
notes: o changes to ue in some forms: devuelvo. Past form: he devuelto.

sentences.text: ¿Cuándo me devuelves el libro?
sentences.translation: When are you giving me the book back?

sentences.text: Devolví los zapatos a la tienda.
sentences.translation: I returned the shoes to the shop.

sentences.text: Todavía no me ha devuelto el dinero.
sentences.translation: He still hasn't paid me back.

sentences.text: ¡Devuélveme eso ahora mismo!
sentences.translation: Give that back to me right now!

sentences.text: Lo pensaré, pero me gusta tu propuesta.
sentences.translation: I'll think about it, but I like your proposal.

sentences.text: El jefe aceptó nuestra propuesta.
sentences.translation: The boss accepted our proposal.

sentences.text: Recibimos tres propuestas distintas.
sentences.translation: We received three different proposals.

sentences.text: Esa cantante tiene una voz preciosa.
sentences.translation: That singer has a beautiful voice.

sentences.text: Mi madre era cantante de joven.
sentences.translation: My mother was a singer when she was young.

sentences.text: Conozco a los cantantes del grupo.
sentences.translation: I know the singers in the band.

sentences.text: No puedo perdonar su traición.
sentences.translation: I can't forgive his betrayal.

sentences.text: En su vida ha sufrido muchas traiciones.
sentences.translation: She has suffered many betrayals in her life.

sentences.text: Para el rey, aquello era traición.
sentences.translation: To the king, that was treason.

sentences.text: Por la noche, los cementerios dan miedo.
sentences.translation: Cemeteries are scary at night.

sentences.text: Mi abuelo está enterrado en este cementerio.
sentences.translation: My grandfather is buried in this cemetery.

sentences.text: Detrás de la iglesia hay un cementerio antiguo.
sentences.translation: Behind the church there's an old cemetery.

sentences.text: Sacamos agua del pozo.
sentences.translation: We get water from the well.

sentences.text: El gato se cayó a un pozo.
sentences.translation: The cat fell into a well.

sentences.text: En el pueblo había varios pozos.
sentences.translation: There were several wells in the village.

notes: A police patrol car is un coche patrulla.

sentences.text: La patrulla encontró el coche abandonado.
sentences.translation: The patrol found the abandoned car.

sentences.text: Los soldados salieron de patrulla.
sentences.translation: The soldiers went out on patrol.

sentences.text: Esta noche habrá más patrullas en el centro.
sentences.translation: Tonight there will be more patrols in the city centre.

sentences.text: Anoche vimos una tragedia en el teatro.
sentences.translation: Last night we saw a tragedy at the theatre.

sentences.text: Perder un partido no es ninguna tragedia.
sentences.translation: Losing a game is no tragedy.

sentences.text: Esa familia ha vivido muchas tragedias.
sentences.translation: That family has been through many tragedies.

sentences.text: Seguimos el procedimiento habitual.
sentences.translation: We followed the usual procedure.

sentences.text: No conozco el procedimiento.
sentences.translation: I don't know the procedure.

sentences.text: Cambiaron los procedimientos de seguridad.
sentences.translation: They changed the safety procedures.

sentences.text: Eso es pura fantasía.
sentences.translation: That's pure fantasy.

sentences.text: Vive en un mundo de fantasía.
sentences.translation: She lives in a fantasy world.

sentences.text: Tiene fantasías de ser rico.
sentences.translation: He has fantasies about being rich.

gloss: ticket (for a train, bus or plane); banknote
notes: A ticket for a concert or a game is an entrada.

sentences.text: Ya tengo el billete de avión.
sentences.translation: I already have my plane ticket.

sentences.text: Saca dos billetes de ida y vuelta.
sentences.translation: Get two return tickets.

sentences.text: Encontré un billete de veinte euros en la calle.
sentences.translation: I found a twenty-euro note in the street.

sentences.text: El secuestro duró tres días.
sentences.translation: The kidnapping lasted three days.

sentences.text: Nadie sabe quién está detrás del secuestro.
sentences.translation: Nobody knows who's behind the kidnapping.

sentences.text: Los secuestros son raros en este país.
sentences.translation: Kidnappings are rare in this country.

gloss: to lend; (prestar atención) to pay attention
notes: To borrow is pedir prestado: me pidió prestado el coche.

sentences.text: ¿Me prestas tu bolígrafo?
sentences.translation: Can you lend me your pen?

sentences.text: Le presté mi coche a mi hermano.
sentences.translation: I lent my car to my brother.

sentences.text: Este libro me lo han prestado.
sentences.translation: This book was lent to me.

sentences.text: No estás prestando atención.
sentences.translation: You're not paying attention.

sentences.text: En España casi nadie juega al béisbol.
sentences.translation: Hardly anyone plays baseball in Spain.

sentences.text: Llevaba una gorra de béisbol.
sentences.translation: He was wearing a baseball cap.

sentences.text: ¿Entiendes las reglas del béisbol?
sentences.translation: Do you understand the rules of baseball?

sentences.text: Busca el significado en internet.
sentences.translation: Look up the meaning on the internet.

sentences.text: Nadie entiende el significado del cuadro.
sentences.translation: Nobody understands the meaning of the painting.

sentences.text: Muchas palabras tienen varios significados.
sentences.translation: Many words have several meanings.

sentences.text: Había unas cincuenta personas en la boda.
sentences.translation: There were about fifty people at the wedding.

sentences.text: Mi abuelo vivió cincuenta años en esta casa.
sentences.translation: My grandfather lived in this house for fifty years.

sentences.text: Aquí no se puede pasar de cincuenta.
sentences.translation: You can't go over fifty here.

gloss: appropriate, proper (fitting for the people or the situation)

sentences.text: Ese chiste no fue nada apropiado.
sentences.translation: That joke wasn't appropriate at all.

sentences.text: ¿Crees que es apropiado llamarla tan tarde?
sentences.translation: Do you think it's appropriate to call her so late?

sentences.text: Su respuesta no fue muy apropiada.
sentences.translation: Her answer wasn't very appropriate.

sentences.text: Mi hija ha hecho un robot con cajas.
sentences.translation: My daughter has made a robot out of boxes.

sentences.text: En esta fábrica casi todo lo hacen robots.
sentences.translation: In this factory, robots do almost everything.

sentences.text: Tenemos un robot que limpia el suelo.
sentences.translation: We have a robot that cleans the floor.

gloss: to consider; to think of (someone as something)

sentences.text: Te considero un buen amigo.
sentences.translation: I consider you a good friend.

sentences.text: ¿Has considerado otras opciones?
sentences.translation: Have you considered other options?

sentences.text: Estamos considerando cambiar de casa.
sentences.translation: We're considering moving house.

gloss: to reach; to catch up with
notes: z changes to c before e: alcancé.

sentences.text: No alcanzo, ¿me lo das?
sentences.translation: I can't reach it, can you pass it to me?

sentences.text: Corrí y la alcancé en la esquina.
sentences.translation: I ran and caught up with her at the corner.

sentences.text: Hemos alcanzado nuestro objetivo.
sentences.translation: We've reached our goal.

notes: In Latin America, papa.

sentences.text: Hoy hay pescado con patatas.
sentences.translation: Today there's fish with potatoes.

sentences.text: Esta patata está mala.
sentences.translation: This potato has gone bad.

sentences.text: ¿Quieres patatas fritas o ensalada?
sentences.translation: Do you want chips or salad?

gloss: continuation, sequel; (a continuación) next, right after

sentences.text: A continuación, el tiempo.
sentences.translation: Next, the weather.

sentences.text: ¿Cuándo sale la continuación del libro?
sentences.translation: When is the sequel to the book coming out?

sentences.text: La reunión de hoy es la continuación de la de ayer.
sentences.translation: Today's meeting is a continuation of yesterday's.

sentences.text: En Navidad, cenar juntos es una tradición.
sentences.translation: At Christmas, having dinner together is a tradition.

sentences.text: Este pueblo tiene muchas tradiciones.
sentences.translation: This village has a lot of traditions.

sentences.text: Por tradición, la novia va de blanco.
sentences.translation: By tradition, the bride wears white.

gloss: to hide, to keep secret (facts, feelings)
notes: Used mostly for facts and feelings; to hide an object, people usually say esconder.

sentences.text: ¿Qué me estás ocultando?
sentences.translation: What are you hiding from me?

sentences.text: No puede ocultar su alegría.
sentences.translation: She can't hide her joy.

sentences.text: Ocultó la verdad durante años.
sentences.translation: He hid the truth for years.

notes: At home, people often call it la luz: pagar la luz.

sentences.text: Cada vez pagamos más por la electricidad.
sentences.translation: We pay more and more for electricity.

sentences.text: La cabaña no tiene electricidad.
sentences.translation: The cabin has no electricity.

sentences.text: Sin electricidad no funciona nada.
sentences.translation: Without electricity nothing works.

sentences.text: Te propongo un reto: un mes sin azúcar.
sentences.translation: Here's a challenge for you: a month without sugar.

sentences.text: Aceptó el reto sin pensarlo.
sentences.translation: He took on the challenge without thinking twice.

sentences.text: Este juego tiene cien retos.
sentences.translation: This game has a hundred challenges.

notes: An aldea is smaller than a pueblo.

sentences.text: Vive en una aldea de veinte habitantes.
sentences.translation: She lives in a hamlet of twenty people.

sentences.text: Para llegar a la aldea hay que caminar una hora.
sentences.translation: To get to the hamlet you have to walk for an hour.

sentences.text: En la montaña quedan muchas aldeas vacías.
sentences.translation: In the mountains there are many empty hamlets.

sentences.text: Llegamos a la cima a mediodía.
sentences.translation: We reached the summit at noon.

sentences.text: Nos hicimos una foto en la cima.
sentences.translation: We took a photo at the top.

sentences.text: Está en la cima de su carrera.
sentences.translation: She's at the peak of her career.

sentences.text: Quedamos a las once en la plaza.
sentences.translation: Let's meet at eleven in the square.

sentences.text: Un equipo de fútbol tiene once jugadores.
sentences.translation: A football team has eleven players.

sentences.text: Su piso está en la planta once.
sentences.translation: Her flat is on the eleventh floor.

sentences.text: Detuvieron a dos terroristas.
sentences.translation: They arrested two terrorists.

sentences.text: El terrorista pasará treinta años en la cárcel.
sentences.translation: The terrorist will spend thirty years in prison.

sentences.text: Los terroristas tenían armas y bombas.
sentences.translation: The terrorists had guns and bombs.

gloss: term (a word; a condition); (por término medio) on average

sentences.text: No entiendo estos términos técnicos.
sentences.translation: I don't understand these technical terms.

sentences.text: Habla en términos más simples, por favor.
sentences.translation: Please speak in simpler terms.

sentences.text: Por término medio, duermo seis horas.
sentences.translation: On average, I sleep six hours.

gloss: (al revés) the wrong way round, upside down, inside out; setback

sentences.text: Has puesto el cuadro al revés.
sentences.translation: You've hung the picture upside down.

sentences.text: Lo has entendido al revés.
sentences.translation: You've got it the wrong way round.

sentences.text: Tras varios reveses, el negocio salió adelante.
sentences.translation: After several setbacks, the business took off.

sentences.text: La bomba explotó en una calle vacía.
sentences.translation: The bomb exploded in an empty street.

sentences.text: Si sigues así, voy a explotar.
sentences.translation: If you keep this up, I'm going to explode.

sentences.text: Esa empresa explota a sus trabajadores.
sentences.translation: That company exploits its workers.

sentences.text: Llevamos a los niños al circo.
sentences.translation: We took the kids to the circus.

sentences.text: En verano vienen dos circos al pueblo.
sentences.translation: In summer two circuses come to the town.

sentences.text: Esta casa parece un circo.
sentences.translation: This house is like a circus.

notes: A fuel or water tank is usually a depósito in Spain.

sentences.text: Los tanques entraron en la ciudad.
sentences.translation: The tanks entered the city.

sentences.text: Había un tanque en el puente.
sentences.translation: There was a tank on the bridge.

sentences.text: Mi tío conducía un tanque en el ejército.
sentences.translation: My uncle drove a tank in the army.

sentences.text: Tengo tierra en las uñas.
sentences.translation: I've got dirt under my nails.

sentences.text: Me he roto una uña.
sentences.translation: I've broken a nail.

sentences.text: Se pinta las uñas de rojo.
sentences.translation: She paints her nails red.
